create_UvicornServer: create a UvicornServer instance with a uvicorn Config to run async tests
start_UvicornServer: start the UvicornServer asynchronously by calling start with optional socket list
shutdown_UvicornServer: shutdown the UvicornServer by cancelling the serve task and waiting for close
test_UvicornServer_lifecycle: test the UvicornServer startup and shutdown lifecycle in an async test
review_UvicornServer: review the UvicornServer class and its async start startup and shutdown methods
